title: Crate
description: Herb's top-song records packed in a plywood crate, seen from above the way you stand over one in a shop: a row of sleeves recedes into the box, top edges catching the light. Drag or scroll to dig: every sleeve you flip past tips forward onto the pile leaning over the front wall, printed back cover and tracklist up, and stands back up when you dig the other way. Tap the front sleeve to lift it out and slide the record.
intent: One record-shop gesture with real depth: a CSS 3D crate with wood grain, shaded inner walls and a contact shadow under a true perspective camera; sleeves have thickness and printed backs, and flipped ones rest on the front lip one sleeve apart, so the pile reads as individual records and nothing ever crosses or fades.
